Commercial LPG Prices Slashed, Domestic Rates Unchanged Amid Global Volatility

Commercial LPG cylinder prices in India have been reduced by approximately ₹183.50, effective July 1. This price cut applies to the 19-kg cylinder used by industrial clients like restaurants and hotels. Domestic LPG cylinder prices, however, remain unchanged, with the government citing increased international benchmark prices and supply costs, particularly following the West Asia conflict, as reasons for not offering domestic relief.
